title: Beginner
description: Learn the board, basic piece movement, and the first habits that keep your games under control.

items.title: Beginner Chess Course
items.description: A structured path through the core beginner lessons.

items.title: Board Basics
items.description: Files, ranks, square names, and board orientation.

items.title: Piece Movement
items.description: Rook, bishop, knight, queen, king, and pawn movement.

items.title: Legal Moves
items.description: Build the habit of choosing moves that make sense from the position.

title: Beginner+
description: Start connecting the opening, tactical, and safety ideas that lead to real improvement.

items.title: Basic Opening Principles
items.description: Control the center, develop pieces, and castle early.

items.title: Basic Tactics
items.description: Forks, pins, skewers, and other simple material wins.

items.title: Blunder Checks
items.description: Train the habit of scanning for hanging pieces and immediate threats.

items.title: Simple Checkmate Patterns
items.description: Learn the most common beginner checkmating ideas without memorizing long lines.

title: Novice
description: Move past basic moves and start seeing the patterns that decide games.

items.title: Checkmate Patterns
items.description: Mate in 1, back-rank mates, queen mates, and smothered mate ideas.

items.title: Forks and Pins
items.description: Learn the two simplest tactical patterns in one place.

items.title: Tactical Awareness
items.description: Spot the moment a piece becomes loose or the king gets trapped.

items.title: Basic Endgames
items.description: King activity, promotion, opposition, and simple winning technique.

title: Intermediate
description: Build deeper understanding with endgame technique, calculation, and planning ideas.

items.title: Endgame Basics
items.description: A longer path through king activity, passed pawns, and simple checkmating technique.

items.title: Intermediate Tactics
items.description: More calculation-heavy patterns and multi-move threats.

items.title: Calculation
items.description: Learn to look a few moves deeper before choosing a move.

items.title: Planning
items.description: Choose a plan that improves all of your pieces together.

title: Advanced Beginner
description: Explore the ideas that start to matter once you stop hanging pieces and start planning real games.

items.title: Positional Play
items.description: Improve pieces, weak squares, and pawn structure decisions.

items.title: Pawn Structures
items.description: Learn the shapes that control which pieces can move well.

items.title: Candidate Moves
items.description: Look at a few serious moves instead of the first move you notice.

items.title: Opening Repertoires
items.description: Start building a personal opening path for both colors.
